subject: Promo stack redline & volume bundle for LaunchForge accelerator
messages:
From: Eric Park <eric@launchforge.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: agreements@launchforge.io
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo stack + legal redline for LaunchForge cohort

Hi Soojin/Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — LaunchForge is excited to move a 12-team cohort onto Redwood for the accelerator pilot. Before we finalize, a couple of asks from our side:

- Can we combine the "starter voucher pool" (free credits) with a volume/dedicated commitment discount? The cohort will run a mix of sandbox and sustained Dedicated runs; we want the vouchers to cover initial experimenting and still let teams convert to Dedicated without losing the promotional value.
- Legal attached a redlined clause that tries to place promotional credits into an escrow and says unused credits revert after 90 days. That seems aggressive for our cohort (many teams ramp slowly). Can you confirm flexibility on promo expiry and whether credits can roll into a 6-month consumption window?
- Procurement will need a PO and our billing team prefers Net-45 on the invoice. Is that acceptable?

Attached: LaunchForge_SOW_v2.pdf and our redline (promo_term_redline.docx).

Goal: get to a signed SOW and DocuSign quick — cohort starts Sep 1.

--
Eric Park
Head of Programs, LaunchForge
eric@launchforge.io

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Park <eric@launchforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Promo stack + legal redline for LaunchForge cohort

Hi Eric — appreciate the clear summary and the redline. Short answers up front: we can combine a voucher pool with a staged discount, and finance is willing to discuss Net-45 for accelerator partners (see internal note below). A few details and a proposal from our side: 

Proposal (commercial):
- Starter voucher pool: $50,000 of free credits (applies to token usage across the account), valid for 6 months from SOW signature.
- Dedicated volume bundle: if cohort aggregate Dedicated consumption exceeds 1,000 GPU-hours within the first 90 days, we’ll apply a 20% discount on Dedicated unit rates for the subsequent 12 months (applies to the specific org/account).
- Promo expiry/rollover: we cannot accept escrow mechanics as drafted. Instead, unused voucher credits will remain valid for the 6-month window; we will allow a one-time 30-day rollover for teams that can demonstrate active ramp plans.

Legal redline: we reviewed the attached doc. The escrow and clawback language is a blocker for us — we typically avoid escrow on promo credits for accelerator programs. I’m looping in Priyom to discuss partner branding and convertibility mechanics (Priyom — can we allow vouchers to convert to a one-time onboarding credit toward Dedicated on request?).

Procurement: we can accept Net-45 for this SOW, subject to finance approval (I’ve pinged Laura in finance). Please share the PO contact and any internal billing codes so we can route correctly.

Next steps: Ben, can you review the numbers and confirm approval to offer the 20% step-down discount and the 6-month voucher term? If yes I’ll prepare a compact commercial addendum and ask legal to push a cleaner promo clause back to LaunchForge legal.

Thanks — aiming to keep timeline tight for Sep 1 start.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo stack + volume bundle — finance input

Soojin/Ben — quick finance note on Net-45 and discount approvals.

- Net-45: Approved for accelerator partnerships, on the condition we have a valid PO and a named billing contact. Please ensure the PO includes LaunchForge billing address and account number.
- Discount: We can approve a step-down discount, but commercial approval is capped at 18% for deals with expected ARR < $250k. For the 20% we would need VP approval (I can escalate if you think cohort consumption will exceed that threshold).
- Revenue recognition / rev-rec: if the vouchers are being treated as a separate deliverable, revenue will be amortized over the 6-month voucher window; please confirm how LaunchForge wants consumption reported.

Attachments: finance_approval_summary.pdf (brief) — I pulled expected revenue bands from HubSpot (link below). If Ben wants me to escalate the extra 2% for 20% total discount, I’ll need a short note on expected committed Dedicated hours or an uplift forecast.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Related HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Park <eric@launchforge.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Promo stack redline & volume bundle for LaunchForge accelerator

Thanks Eric — appreciate the redline and the SOW. Quick commercial confirmation and next steps from our side: 

1) Commercial terms agreed (high level):
   - Starter voucher pool: $50k free credits, valid 6 months from signature, one-time 30-day rollover as described.
   - Dedicated volume bundle: 20% step-down discount on Dedicated unit rates for 12 months contingent on meeting the 1,000 GPU-hour trigger in the first 90 days.
   - Note from finance: Laura can approve 18% without VP sign-off; I’m requesting one additional internal note to push to 20% given cohort intent and strategic value.

2) Legal: We cannot accept escrow for promo credits. We will provide a clean promo clause that permits conversion requests and a limited rollover. See attached summary. Please have your agreements team accept the alternative clause or mark further redlines.

3) Procurement & invoicing:
   - LaunchForge Net-45: accepted pending PO and billing contact. Laura will generate the invoice once PO and signed SOW are in.
   - Please submit the PO to billing@redwood.ai and include the LaunchForge billing contact.

4) Operational next steps:
   - Eric — please countersign the SOW and return via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/exec/abcdef (SOW id: LF-SOW-2027-07)
   - Laura will hold the invoice until PO receipt (billing@redwood.ai).
   - Priyom/Partnerships team will schedule a 30-min onboarding call the week after signature to review voucher allocation and onboarding templates.

If all good, we’ll push the SOW to DocuSign today and aim to have the deal fully executed by Friday. Thanks everyone — excited to get the cohort live.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: LaunchForge_SOW_v2.pdf (for signature), promo_term_summary.pdf
